description: Reddit community discussions from Reddit's public RSS feeds: top posts of a subreddit for hour/day/week/month/year/all, or one thread (post id) with its visible comments. Feeds carry title, author, link, date and text only; no scores or comment counts. Reddit may rate-limit (503). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

period.description: hour, day, week, month, year or all (default day). Used for the listing

post.description: Optional Reddit post id (e.g. 1x9uihs). When set, returns that thread and its comments

subreddit.description: Subreddit name without r/ (2-21 letters, digits or _). Default technology
